Snip-Snap Documentation

Snip-Snap is a UK barbershop discovery web application built with Python/Flask and PostgreSQL (via Supabase). It lets customers find local barbers on an interactive map, browse a rated infinite-scroll feed of haircut posts, and leave reviews. Barbers can manage their profile, timetable, and post gallery from a dashboard.
